data_model.customer: 1001 if n mod 10 < 7, otherwise 1002 + (17*n + seed) mod 999
data_model.status: paid when (53*n+seed) mod 100 is below90 for October offsets273–303 or below10 otherwise; pending otherwise
data_model.native_projection: order_id, customer_id, placed_at, status only; no generated stock/payments inferred

comparison: All four indexes declared inside CREATE TABLE before loading; explicit path hints compare mechanisms. All eight customer/bound/status combinations return equal ordered results through all four paths. No ordinary repetitions, write-load test or distributed cluster run.

schema.create_statement:
CREATE TABLE public.orders (
	order_id INT8 NOT NULL,
	customer_id INT8 NOT NULL,
	placed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
	status STRING NOT NULL,
	crdb_internal_customer_id_order_id_placed_at_shard_4 INT8 NOT VISIBLE NOT NULL AS (mod(fnv32(md5(crdb_internal.datums_to_bytes(customer_id, order_id, placed_at))), 4:::INT8)) VIRTUAL,
	crdb_internal_customer_id_shard_4 INT8 NOT VISIBLE NOT NULL AS (mod(fnv32(md5(crdb_internal.datums_to_bytes(customer_id))), 4:::INT8)) VIRTUAL,
	CONSTRAINT orders_pkey PRIMARY KEY (order_id ASC),
	INDEX orders_history (customer_id ASC, placed_at DESC, order_id DESC),
	INDEX orders_history_cover (customer_id ASC, placed_at DESC, order_id DESC) STORING (status),
	INDEX orders_history_hash (customer_id ASC, placed_at DESC, order_id DESC) USING HASH STORING (status) WITH (bucket_count=4),
	INDEX orders_history_prefix (customer_id ASC, placed_at DESC, order_id DESC) USING HASH STORING (status) WITH (bucket_count=4, shard_columns=(customer_id))
) WITH (schema_locked = true);
